title: Publish Foam Daddy Storefront (production release)

requirements.text: Publish the current Foam Daddy Storefront so it is publicly accessible as a non-expiring live deployment, ensuring the public routes work without authentication and admin routes remain gated behind Internet Identity.
acceptanceCriteria: A production build is created and released as the live/published version (not a temporary draft).
Visiting the homepage ("/") does not require login and loads successfully.
Public routes (/products, /product/:productId, /cart, /checkout, /request-quote) are accessible without authentication and function end-to-end.
Admin routes (/admin/*) still require Internet Identity authentication and proper role checks.
SPA deep links work after publish (unknown routes fall back to the app shell via the existing 404 fallback).
The Share button copies the deployed (non-localhost) URL correctly when tested on the live deployment.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all Motoko backend logic in the single actor (backend/main.mo); add a migration file only if state schema changes are required.
All user-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Adding a way to disable or modify the platform’s automatic draft-expiration behavior.
Introducing external hosting providers, databases, or non-supported deployment infrastructure.
